notes.title: Devlog #09: Urgent Bug Fixes for "The Experiment of the Great Old Ones" Update
notes.notes:
Key Updates

 Fixed a crash issue in Evil God Mode - Yama.
 Fixed a potential crash caused by Sheriff - Skill 1.
 Fixed issues with weapon level loss and some talents being recalculated after loading a game in Infinite Dungeon.
 Clarified how to obtain gold frames for characters: either complete Hell Mode or reach level 6-6 in Infinite Dungeon using the corresponding character.

Bug Fixes

 Demon King's Rick's Teleport Gun fails to deal damage.
 Executioner - Skill 3 unable to summon after 10 triggers.
 immortal Mode - Formless Buddha allows only 5 talents to be selected in 3-player co-op.
 Hell Messenger - Skill 2 issues with some weapon projectiles not transforming.
 Chaos Card occasionally fails to instantly defeat certain bosses.
 Engineer's drones fail to trigger additional lightning damage from Electro Musician.
 Theology of the Evil God automatically interacts with the nearest item when triggered.
 Dawarshi - Skill 3 has a chance to be ineffective in Infinite Dungeon.
 Dawarshi - Skill 1 talent Property Mortgage does not take effect.

notes.title: Devlog #08: Regular Bug Fixes and Maintenance
notes.notes:
Major Updates

 Fixed an issue in "Infinite Dungeon" where weapons on the ground disappeared after loading a save.
 Resolved a problem where certain weapons associated with the talents "Force Awakening," "Demon Gunner," and "Rear Gun Clutch" would vanish after loading a save in "Infinite Dungeon" mode.

Bug Fixes

 Buffs provided by "ACGN Girl - Skill 3" in "Infinite Dungeon" mode disappeared after loading a save.
 The "Red Blessing: Recycling Plant" disappeared when loading a save.
 Loading a save after consuming Divine Technique Beer would switch the divine technique.
 The Soul Scythe would not attack by default in soul state.
 Playing as "Commando" in "God Mode - Zhao Gongming" prevented the unlocking of melee divine weapons.
 The "Void Devourer's" instant death upon revival could be blocked by some invulnerability effects.
 Unable to exit the chapter selection by pressing ESC.
 Using a controller with "Ranger - Skill 1" could cause buffs to become ineffective.
 Optimized the performance of talents like "Soul Penetration."

Balance Adjustments

 Increased the damage dealt by the third attack of all two-handed axes by 25%.
 Increased the damage of all single-shot sniper rifles by 50%.

Other Adjustments

 Some sound effects were still audible even when muted.
 Added support for 32:9 screen aspect ratio.

notes.title: Eastern Game Fest & 2024 Update Roadmap！
notes.notes:
Hello, Players!

"Flourish in Games, Share with the World" — the Steam Eastern Game Fest is now underway! 
From April 26 to May 4, Apocalypse Party joins over 400 games in celebrating the feast of Eastern gaming culture, in collaboration with Steam and Steam China.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/2ef48460fba2db6e26d5302a14fd4a7005dfc324.png

Beyond the festivities, we know that what you're most eager to hear about is our "2024 Update Roadmap"! 

 Following the footsteps of March's major free update, we will bring you a content-rich DLC update this sweltering summer! 
 Later in the year, we're excited to introduce the much-anticipated Workshop!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/764d3f00e6e01d673cbc72bcbcfa3c47e606a053.png

In addition to our dedication to developing new content, please be assured: 
We are also seriously listening to your feedback about game issues. 
Seeing your comments and messages fills us with joy, knowing so many of you are enjoying our game and taking the time to offer suggestions. It also brings pressure, as we recognize there are many aspects of the game that still need optimization and fixing (especially as new updates often introduce unexpected bugs).

Here, we express our gratitude for your understanding and patience with Apocalypse Party. 
We sincerely thank everyone who has supported and played our game and offer our heartfelt apologies to those who have had less than favorable experiences. 

Gaming should bring joy, and creating games should deliver joy. 
Poor experiences are neither our intention nor something we take lightly; they are merely the complex realities of development that sometimes exceed our expectations. We know there's much more we can and need to do. We will keep listening to you and bring more new content. 

"Ensuring our games are worth buying and joyful to play" has always been the driving force behind our small indie team.

Thank you for being with us.



- The Apocalypse Party Team

notes.title: Devlog #07: Swordmaster Comprehensive Upgrade & Urgent Bug Fixes in New Release
notes.notes:
Key Updates

 Fixed several new multiplayer crashes to improve online stability.
 Fixed talent loss issues in "Infinite Dungeon" for "Demon Gunner," "Force Awakening," and "Gun in Booty" after loading saves.
 Fixed issue where unlocking achievements such as 'Apocalypse Party' and 'Breaker Games' for all characters using the skull was not functioning correctly.
 Addressed the problem of monsters having zero health after level 100 in "Infinite Dungeon."
 Introduced two new beers, "Divine Technique" and "Soul," in the tavern.
 Added a dragon with the "Dark" attribute.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the "Swordmaster - Skill 2" could not upgrade weapon quality.
 Addressed the malfunction of "Blacksmith - Skill 2."
 Resolved the issue in "Immortal Mode" where players could select duplicate talents that did not activate.
 Fixed the inoperative "Red Blessing: Recycling Plant."
 Hosts can now select "Immortal Mode" in multiplayer.
 In "Immortal Mode - Formless Buddha," only the host's UI was hidden.
 "Undead - Skill 2" did not work in "Immortal Mode - Night God Moon."
 The "Mary Sue" talent was negating the "Undead" buffs.

Balance Adjustments

 The new character "Swordmaster" has been fully upgraded with his three skills’ weapons upgradable to three special orange weapons, including "Wandering Dragon."
 After upgrading to an orange weapon, the "Swordmaster" can automatically pick up nearby weapons during charge.
 Changed "Gravity" elite monsters to trigger intermittently.

Other Adjustments

 "Immortal Mode" will no longer trigger cheat detection.
 Modified the text description for "Probability" beer.

notes.title: Devlog #2: We're Listening, and Making Real Changes!
notes.notes:
Dear "Apocalypse Party" Players,

First and foremost, we are genuinely grateful for your support.
We recognize that every player is an indispensable part of the "Apocalypse" world, and we take every piece of feedback seriously! For instance, some of you mentioned concerns like: the gameplay not being thrilling enough, the level cap being too low, and some content requiring online play to unlock, etc.

We've changed them all! And the changes are effective immediately!

Therefore, we've worked tirelessly through the night, and after ensuring the online server crash issue was resolved, we are excited to bring you this "Devlog #2":

 All content previously unlockable only in online mode can now be unlocked in single-player mode.
 Increased the level cap to 25.
 Optimized the talent algorithm (reduced randomness, making it easier to form a consistent playstyle. Removed the restriction of no gold talents before level 7).
 Default number of talent resets increased to 6.
 Simplified unlock conditions for certain characters (like Beastmaster/Bard/Epidemiologist, etc.).
 Enhanced the numerical values of some character skills.
 In online play, the buffs triggered by statues now cover the entire team.
 Initiated a preliminary anti-cheat detection feature.
 Resolved a number of other serious bugs and crash issues (still in ongoing optimization).
PS: Remember to restart Steam to detect the version update.

We understand that in this rapidly evolving gaming world, only by continuously listening and swiftly responding can our game meet your expectations.

We sincerely hope these updates and improvements let players feel our dedication and commitment to the quality of the game. Please believe that our passion for "Apocalypse Party" is as deep as yours, and we are confident about the continual updates and optimizations in the future.

Once again, thank you for your companionship, support, and understanding throughout this process. We look forward to witnessing every moment of growth in "Apocalypse Party" with you. Thank you.


Best Regards,
The Entire Dev and Operations Team of Apocalypse Party

notes.title: Apocalypse Party Release Date Announced – Join the Carnival on Dec 1st!
notes.notes:
Hello, Gamers!

After an intense three-week grind, we are thrilled to announce today that Apocalypse Party will officially launch on December 1st!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/61fe6006fe9b53329efd5d36b977e6e01b0fc8b9.png
The Steam Next Fest brought us an overwhelming number of creative thoughts and feedback, inspiring us to expand our original plan of 350 talents to over 500. In addition, we've added 20 exciting map Easter eggs, hoping they'll bring a knowing smile to your face when discovered.

We've also focused on highly requested features, including significant performance optimizations, enhanced controller support, and the squashing of a mountain of bugs.

Looking back since the demo's release, your attention and affection have exceeded our wildest dreams. We sincerely thank you all. This overwhelming response has driven us to work even harder to present the game in a richer and more enjoyable way to everyone who loves it.

Moreover, we'd like to share some upcoming new plans already on our agenda:
[olist]
 Free Crossover DLC: As avid fans and developers of roguelike games, we've actively invited other leading roguelike studios to collaborate. Post-launch, we'll release a small crossover DLC featuring new characters, orange weapons, and extraordinary talents – all for free!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/2a9d12480fa3c1ae5e523b1da751d3195a4525ca.png
 Creative Workshop: We've always believed that player creativity is key to a game's ongoing vitality. Therefore, we'll be opening a Creative Workshop after the game's release, enabling everyone to freely create content they love. We can't wait to see your imaginative creations!
[/olist]
Finally, we want to express our gratitude to all the players who have supported and encouraged us. Post-launch, we will actively gather your suggestions and feedback, doubling our efforts to bring you an entertaining game.

In conclusion, thank you once again for your support! We look forward to seeing you on December 1st!

notes.title: Apology Announcement for the Delayed Release
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

After much reflection and consideration, we have made the difficult decision to slightly postpone the release of "Apocalypse Party" with a new launch planned for December. We sincerely apologize for this delay.

"The true test of a game is in its play!" It's become clear that participating in the Steam Next Fest and releasing a game demo for players to try was the right move for us. During this time, our passionate community has helped identify many bugs and has even offered numerous interesting suggestions to enhance the gaming experience. We've carefully recorded all these suggestions and thoughtfully considered them, ultimately deciding to implement an additional round of optimization and modifications to the game.

Making a decision to delay a release is never easy. However, we believe it's more crucial to present a game version that players will understand, appreciate, and truly enjoy rather than rush a potentially unsatisfying one. We have chosen the latter and sincerely hope for your understanding and patience. We don’t want to keep our devoted fans waiting too long, so we will first address the most critical changes to ensure a swift release, with continuous improvements based on your feedback to follow.

To express our regret and to show our gratitude for our ever-supportive community, we are hosting a small event from November 3rd to November 13th. Recognizing the joy many of our fans derive from playing with friends, we'll draw winners in pairs of two keys each. The event details are straightforward and will be announced on the day. We genuinely hope you'll join us.

Lastly, we invite any and all feedback about our game. Please feel free to leave comments and interact with us on our official Twitter and YouTube channels.

While "Apocalypse Party" may not yet be perfect, we are dedicated to pouring our heart and soul into it, making whatever tough choices are necessary, all in the hopes of creating a game that you love. We deeply appreciate your invaluable suggestions and the unwavering support and encouragement you've shown us. Once more, for the delay, we sincerely say: "We're sorry."

Best regards,
The "Apocalypse Party" Dev Team
